job: Switch teams, reach help and docs, and take the one primary action.
purpose: The sticky bar above the page: the team switcher on the left, quiet tools and one primary action on the right. It is translucent and blurred so content scrolls under it. On phones it keeps the brand tile, team, notifications and the menu button. A theme toggle cycles light, dark and system.
useWhen: Every screen in the shell needs the team, help and one upgrade or create action in the same place.
The search palette needs a trigger.

parts.role: A page title when the bar carries one.
